content:
Field
Description
TotalDiskSpace
Total amount of disk space available on the system in GB. On Windows, includes space on logical fixed drives only.
NumberOfDiskDrives Number of active disk drives available on the system. On Windows, includes logical fixed drives only.
IndividualDiskInfo
Individual disk capacity information for each disk on the system, formatted in the following format:
"[version],[name of first disk]|[capacity in GB],[name of second disk]|[capacity in GB],[name of third disk]|[capacity in GB]"
top [#top]
